theorem Dense.continuous_lowerBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    lowerBounds (f '' S) = lowerBounds (range f) := by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ fun _ => lowerBounds_mono (Set.image_subset_range f S) le_rfl
  refine subset_trans ?_ fun _ => lowerBounds_mono (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS) le_rfl
  intro x hx i hi
  rw [mem_closure_iff_frequently] at hi
  exact (hi.mono hx).mem_of_closed isClosed_Ici

theorem Dense.continuous_upperBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    upperBounds (f '' S) = upperBounds (range f) :=
  (upperBounds_closure (f '' S) ▸ upperBounds_mono_set
    (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS)).antisymm (upperBounds_mono_set (image_subset_range f S))

theorem Dense.continuous_lowerBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    lowerBounds (f '' S) = lowerBounds (range f) :=
  hS.continuous_upperBounds (α := αᵒᵈ) hf

theorem Dense.continuous_inf {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddBelow (range f)) :
    ⨅ i, f i = ⨅ s : S, f s :=
  hS.continuous_sup (α := αᵒᵈ) hf h

theorem Dense.continuous_inf' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨅ i, f i = ⨅ s : S, f s :=
  hS.continuous_sup' (α := αᵒᵈ) hf

theorem Dense.continuous_sup' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s := by
  by_cases h : BddAbove (range f)
  · exact hS.continuous_sup hf h
  have h' : ¬BddAbove (range fun s : S ↦ f s) := by
    rwa [← image_eq_range, BddAbove, hS.continuous_upperBounds hf]
  rw [iSup, iSup, csSup_of_not_bddAbove h, csSup_of_not_bddAbove h']

theorem Dense.continuous_sup {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddAbove (range f)) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [iSup_of_empty']
  exact (isLUB_ciSup h).unique <| (isLUB_congr (hS.continuous_upperBounds hf)).mp <|
    isLUB_ciSup_set (h.mono (image_subset_range f S)) hS.nonempty

/-- If `f` is continuous and `S` is dense, then `f '' S` and `range f` have the same upper
bounds. -/
theorem Dense.upperBounds_image {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α} {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    upperBounds (f '' S) = upperBounds (range f) :=
  (upperBounds_closure (f '' S) ▸
    upperBounds_mono_set (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS)).antisymm <|
    upperBounds_mono_set (image_subset_range f S)

/-- If `f` is continuous and `S` is dense, then `f '' S` and `range f` have the same lower
bounds. -/
theorem Dense.lowerBounds_image {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIciTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α} {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    lowerBounds (f '' S) = lowerBounds (range f) :=
  hS.upperBounds_image (α := αᵒᵈ) hf

/-- The supremum of a continuous function that is bounded above equals its supremum over any
dense set. -/
theorem Dense.ciSup_eq_ciSup_subtype {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIicTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α}
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddAbove (range f)) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [iSup_of_empty']
  exact (isLUB_ciSup h).unique <| (isLUB_congr (hS.upperBounds_image hf)).mp <|
    isLUB_ciSup_set (h.mono (image_subset_range f S)) hS.nonempty

/-- The infimum of a continuous function that is bounded below equals its infimum over any
dense set. -/
theorem Dense.ciInf_eq_ciInf_subtype {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIciTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α}
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddBelow (range f)) :
    ⨅ i, f i = ⨅ s : S, f s :=
  hS.ciSup_eq_ciSup_subtype (α := αᵒᵈ) hf h

/-- A version of `Dense.ciSup_eq_ciSup_subtype` for functions taking values in a conditionally
complete linear order, where the assumption `BddAbove (range f)` is not needed. -/
theorem Dense.ciSup_eq_ciSup_subtype' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIicTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α}
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s := by
  by_cases h : BddAbove (range f)
  · exact hS.ciSup_eq_ciSup_subtype hf h
  have h' : ¬BddAbove (range fun s : S ↦ f s) := by
    rwa [← image_eq_range, BddAbove, hS.upperBounds_image hf]
  rw [iSup, iSup, csSup_of_not_bddAbove h, csSup_of_not_bddAbove h']

/-- A version of `Dense.ciInf_eq_ciInf_subtype` for functions taking values in a conditionally
complete linear order, where the assumption `BddBelow (range f)` is not needed. -/
theorem Dense.ciInf_eq_ciInf_subtype' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIciTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α}
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨅ i, f i = ⨅ s : S, f s :=
  hS.ciSup_eq_ciSup_subtype' (α := αᵒᵈ) hf

theorem DenseRange.upperBounds_range_comp {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α} {g : β → γ} (hg : DenseRange g)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    upperBounds (range (f ∘ g)) = upperBounds (range f) := by
  rw [range_comp]
  exact Dense.continuous_upperBounds hg hf

theorem DenseRange.ciSup_comp {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIicTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α}
    {g : β → γ} (hg : DenseRange g) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddAbove (range f)) :
    ⨆ b, f (g b) = ⨆ i, f i := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [iSup_of_empty', hg.isEmpty_iff.mpr ‹_›]
  have : Nonempty β := hg.nonempty
  exact (isLUB_ciSup (h.mono (range_comp_subset_range g f))).unique <|
    (isLUB_congr (hg.upperBounds_range_comp hf)).mpr (isLUB_ciSup h)

example {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddAbove (range f)) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s :=
  (hS.denseRange_val.ciSup_comp hf h).symm

theorem DenseRange.upperBounds_range_comp {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α} {g : β → γ} (hg : DenseRange g)
    (hf : Continuous f) :

theorem DenseRange.ciSup_comp {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIicTopology α] [TopologicalSpace γ] {f : γ → α}
    {g : β → γ} (hg : DenseRange g) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddAbove (range f)) :
    ⨆ b, f (g b) = ⨆ i, f i := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · have : IsEmpty β := ⟨fun b ↦ isEmptyElim (g b)⟩
    simp [iSup_of_empty']
  have : Nonempty β := hg.nonempty
  exact (isLUB_ciSup (h.mono (range_comp_subset_range g f))).unique <|
    (isLUB_congr (hg.upperBounds_range_comp hf)).mpr (isLUB_ciSup h)
